create_video_llava_processor: create a VideoLlavaVideoProcessor instance for processing video frames with CLIP normalization
configure_video_processor_resize: configure the VideoLlavaVideoProcessor to resize video frames to 224x224 with BICUBIC resampling
set_video_processor_crop_size: set the VideoLlavaVideoProcessor crop size to 224 height and 224 width for center cropping
configure_video_processor_normalization: configure the VideoLlavaVideoProcessor to normalize video frames using OPENAI_CLIP mean and std values
setup_video_processor_rgb_conversion: setup the VideoLlavaVideoProcessor to convert video frames to RGB with rescaling and center cropping enabled
